description: Runs the three-question FHA multifamily program chooser from fhamultifamily.loan/chooser: returns the likely program (223(f), 221(d)(4) new construction or substantial rehab, 223(a)(7), 241(a), or "not FHA yet"), the reason, and the program page to read next.

built.description: Only when has_fha_loan is false: is the property built and operating (false = land or a construction project)? Default true.

condition.description: Only when has_fha_loan is false and built is true. heavy_renovation means more than about $55,096 a unit of work. Default stabilized_3_plus_years.

has_fha_loan.description: Does the property already have an FHA-insured mortgage?

need.description: Only when has_fha_loan is true: what the owner needs. Default lower_rate_no_cash_out.

name: choose_program
title: Which FHA multifamily program fits
